changeSummary: Zero Trust runtime decision prompt in the v20 dictionary format: every user prompt line an entry of the prompt dictionary, drawn in its blocks (W3-1, W3-2); each past record on one line in a fixed order, its search started at the request (W3-3, W3-4); the items the user approved for removal left out (Q-61: summaries that restate other lines, the memory guardrails and the cohort seed policy; Q-73: the prompt-quality verification mark and the sentences that restate a coverage level) and the other facts kept as dictionary entries (W3-5); untrusted texts in a block of their own (W3-6); budget trimming by the dictionary priorities without cutting a fact value (W3-7); the parts that do not change first, with a prompt cache key (W3-8); a Layer2 second pass that adds only what it found (W3-9); the kinds of missing knowledge, source grades and data conflicts (W3-12); fact IDs and relative times (W3-13); runtime rules under the dictionary names (W3-14); the past records read by an exact lookup within the action family and counted on the request's target, on other targets and through its entry point, the records shown its target's first, then the latest, then by stored ID, with no similarity field and no decision in the embedded text (W3-18); a fact two lines state drawn from one source: the evidence line's baseline state is the status line's, whether the device was seen before is the decision facts' comparison or names its source, and the number of past records is the exact lookup's count, each of the three stated once (W3-19, Q-79); the lines a reason code may cite carry the fact ID of their block in every cited block (B, S, R, F, P; P3 extra 12); the differences from the usual stated in one dictionary form with or without a difference, the closest past record read for the action included (P3 extra 39); the fact lines without the instructions written with their facts (TO-1 to TO-3) and the UNKNOWN form from the renderer's words (P3 extra 37)
